g.text: PCM5102A BREAKOUT FOOTPRINT IS PROVISIONAL - MEASURE PHYSICAL MODULE BEFORE FABRICATION

g.desc: PCM5102A BREAKOUT FOOTPRINT IS PROVISIONAL - MEASURE PHYSICAL MODULE BEFORE FABRICATION

g.text: DESIGN NOTE: master uses PTV111-3415A-B103 (rear-facing shaft). The originally requested -1415A is vertical-shaft and mechanically incompatible with a rear panel.

g.desc: DESIGN NOTE: master uses PTV111-3415A-B103 (rear-facing shaft). The originally requested -1415A is vertical-shaft and mechanically incompatible with a rear panel.

g.text: ESP-DubSiren V1 — ESP32-S3 native USB / PCM5122 / MCP3208 / MCP23017

g.desc: ESP-DubSiren V1 — ESP32-S3 native USB / PCM5122 / MCP3208 / MCP23017

g.text: CHASSIS is isolated from circuit GND by default; R17/C16 are DNP configuration options. USB shield and connector shell land on CHASSIS.

g.desc: CHASSIS is isolated from circuit GND by default; R17/C16 are DNP configuration options. USB shield and connector shell land on CHASSIS.

g.text: PCM5122 module U6 follows Adafruit 6421 dual-header pin order; MCLK is intentionally unused. Native USB D+/D- include USBLC6-2 and 22R series damping.

g.desc: PCM5122 module U6 follows Adafruit 6421 dual-header pin order; MCLK is intentionally unused. Native USB D+/D- include USBLC6-2 and 22R series damping.

g.text: V0 MECHANICAL PROTOTYPE: CONTROL NETS ARE INTENTIONALLY NOT ASSIGNED TO ESP32 GPIO
